selection_scope: one shared profile per dataset for clean and noisy runs

yelp2018.evidence: SSM tau/dropout/decay follow the corrected Yelp robust search; filtering and modulation use the selected shared full-method profile.

amazon-book.evidence: SSM tau/decay follow the Amazon objective pilot; filtering and modulation use the selected shared full-method profile.

lastfm.evidence: SSM tau/decay and CrossNorm weight follow the LastFM convergence, decay, and norm sensitivity studies; filtering uses the selected 4% profile.

ml-1m.evidence: SSM tau/decay and CrossNorm weight follow the ML-1M convergence, decay, and norm sensitivity studies; filtering uses the selected 0.5% profile.

arms.lightgcn: SSM with no edge filtering and no CrossNorm
arms.filter_only: SSM with structure-momentum hard filtering only
arms.full: SSM with structure-momentum hard filtering plus CrossNorm blend

notes: SSM momentum is the EMA of the detached in-batch per-interaction SSM loss computed by the optimization forward pass.
Because in-batch negatives depend on batch composition, the SSM momentum signal is batch-context dependent; EMA smoothing and stable edge IDs are used before filtering.
Filter and CrossNorm parameters are shared across noise ratios and are not selected using synthetic labels.
Learning rates are arm-specific by request: no-CrossNorm variants use 1e-3 and CrossNorm variants use 5e-4.
